items.title: 关于开展研发业务数字化平台公开寻源工作的通知
items.excerpt: AECC opened sourcing for seven aircraft-engine R&D digital platforms covering virtual concept studies, requirements, MBSE system modeling, digital test control, integrated project management and joint simulation. Requirements include cloud-native architecture and bidirectional integration with AI agents.

items.title: 中国航发召开2026年战略研讨会
items.excerpt: AECC's Aug. 30–31 strategic seminar organized focused forums on military propulsion, commercial propulsion, civil gas turbines, airborne systems and advanced materials while setting mid- and long-term priorities. The release is strategic rather than a product milestone.

items.title: 中航西飞招标：资金已落实 研制平台国产化改造 筑牢自主根基
items.excerpt: Sina reports an Aug. 26 AVIC Xi'an Aircraft tender to migrate and modify a design-manufacturing collaborative R&D platform for domestic OS, database and middleware environments, with development, testing, deployment, training and staged acceptance requirements.

items.title: 中航西飞招标：自筹资金购钛合金检测单元 赋能航产智造升级
items.excerpt: Sina reports an Aug. 19 AVIC Xi'an Aircraft re-tender for an automated inspection unit within a titanium-structure flexible machining cell. The system includes a coordinate-measuring machine, automated exchange equipment and integrated measurement control for dimensional and geometric inspection.

items.title: Airbus kicks off wing facility extension, with major investment into Belfast site
items.excerpt: Airbus started a 6,221 m² Belfast A220-wing facility extension due in H1 2028, adding a third autoclave, tooling and cranage for a planned 13-aircraft/month rate. Airbus says its patented resin-transfer-infusion composite wing structure is about 10% lighter than aluminium equivalents.
items.query: site:airbus.com 2026-08 Belfast wing facility composite manufacturing A220

items.title: Senior Digital Engineering (DE) Process Engineer
items.excerpt: A Boeing Defense, Space & Security role supports a proprietary Air Dominance program maturing a next-generation Digital Engineering and PLM system for engineering and manufacturing, using Teamcenter/NX and linking PDM with analysis, simulation, manufacturing, ERP and MES workflows.
items.query: site:jobs.boeing.com 2026 September Digital Engineering PLM Air Dominance Teamcenter

items.title: Investing in the Future: Lockheed Martin Ventures Demo Day 2026
items.excerpt: Lockheed Martin Ventures brought 18 portfolio companies to its 2026 Demo Day; current investment themes include advanced manufacturing, quantum technologies and next-generation propulsion. Demonstrations ranged from software-defined foundry systems to detonation-engine propulsion.
items.query: site:lockheedmartin.com 2026 September Ventures Demo Day advanced manufacturing propulsion

items.title: Northrop Grumman Advances Microchip Tech with Diamond Cooling Innovation
items.excerpt: Northrop Grumman received a $7 million DARPA THREADS Phase 2 contract for diamond-cooled RF chips. The company reports Phase 1 increased power by 3.3× and plans more than another 3× increase by growing diamond in backside microchannels to move heat away from hotspots.

items.title: Northrop Grumman Delivers E-2D Advanced Hawkeye's Most Significant Upgrade in Platform History
items.excerpt: Northrop Grumman completed the government-led critical design review for E-2D Block II, clearing integration and test. The upgrade uses a modular open systems approach and commercial off-the-shelf products and will be integrated into new-production aircraft and retrofit into the existing fleet.
items.query: site:news.northropgrumman.com E-2D Block II critical design review August 2026

items.title: BAE Systems advances to Phase 2 of DARPA’s THREADS program
items.excerpt: BAE Systems FAST Labs completed THREADS Phase 1 and moved to Phase 2 to address device-scale thermal limits in high-performance GaN RF electronics. BAE says its material and process work targets substantially higher RF-system power and range through improved heat removal.
items.query: site:baesystems.com 2026 August THREADS GaN thermal management FAST Labs

items.title: Curtiss-Wright to Provide Sensor Processing for Northrop Grumman’s Improved Threat Detection System
items.excerpt: Curtiss-Wright won an approximately $14 million Northrop Grumman contract for sensor-processing equipment for the U.S. Army ITDS aircraft-survivability program, paired with the ATHENA sensor. Discovery candidate: strong recurring relevance in open-architecture avionics, rugged compute and aircraft systems integration.
items.query: Curtiss-Wright Northrop Grumman ITDS sensor processing September 2026 open architecture
